title: Shared definitions
description: Values used by several library files. The other schemas refer to them as common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

decimal.description: An exact decimal, written as a string in its shortest form: "1500", "0.1", "-310.2" (never "1500.00"). The app also reads a plain JSON number, but never through binary floating point. No grouping separators, no leading +, no units.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, with no time or time zone. A value dated 2026-09-30 means "as of the end of that day".

slug.description: An ID: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique within its folder and the same as the file name without .json. The app makes it from the display name ("Conto Fineco" → conto-fineco, adding -2 when taken). An ID never changes; files refer to each other by ID, never by name.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 currency code: EUR, USD, CHF.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code: IT, IE, DE.

assetClass.$comment: Open enum: a value a newer version adds is read and written back as it is.

assetMix.description: A split across asset classes, as fractions that add up to 1: { "equity": "0.6", "bonds": "0.4" }. Classes left out have no share.

dataSource.description: Where a record's values came from: manual (typed in), import (a spreadsheet), ledger (a journal, imported by an earlier version), or the service that answered: yahoo, coingecko, gold-api, ecb, eurostat. A price fetched for a past date has the source of the service that answered, which can differ from its instrument's priceSource (gold priced from Yahoo Finance's GC=F futures has "yahoo").
